propositions: binding_store.py exceeds sustainable complexity (800 lines) mixing identity policy with file loading, JSON encoding, tempfile cleanup, and alert persistence, risking silent data loss during refactoring

extract a private BindingRepository unit-of-work that owns paths and original dictionaries while preserving every byte, exception contract, and load/save ordering without introducing multi-file atomicity

preserve exact sorted/indented/newline serialization, rotation-before-live ordering, retired-first move sequencing, and best-effort alert writes through facade delegation without changing BindingStore public signatures or shared inner state
maintain external tickets publication seam (five files via reconcile_helpers.py) unchanged, with no staging at local checkpoints and no eager rewrites of legacy records with unknown fields

given fault injection (tempfile, rotation replace, retired replace, live replace, alert write failures), tests must assert exact surviving files/bytes, raised versus swallowed exceptions, and unchanged HEAD where applicable
document repository unit-of-work durability, ordered partial-state recovery, selective publication boundary, and no-journal/no-format-migration decision in binding-lifecycle ADR
